Planar Restaurant
ICC Sydney, Shop C08, Ground Floor/14 Darling Dr, Darling Harbour NSW 2000, Australia
Free
detail.description:
Sydney - Alumni Coffee and Catch-Up

Join fellow Tartans in Sydney for a relaxed and informal coffee gathering. This is a great opportunity to reconnect with familiar faces and meet fellow Tartans in the area. Whether you’re new to Sydney or a long-time resident, all alumni and friends are welcome.

Questions? Contact alumni-house@andrew.cmu.edu.
